subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Excessive
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e. 'Moderate'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Excessive"** means more than what is necessary, normal, or desirable; immoderate. (अतिरिक्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The excessive heat made it hard to work outside.
 
 
 
• **"Moderate"** refers to something that is average in amount, intensity, quality, or degree. (सामान्य)
 
 
• **Example:** He made a moderate income from his part-time job.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Moderate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flow** (प्रवाह): The action or fact of moving along in a steady, continuous stream.

 
 
• **Example:** The flow of the river was calm and gentle.
 
 
 
• **Inordinate** (अत्यधिक): Exceeding reasonable limits; excessive.
 
 
• **Example:** She spent an inordinate amount of time on the phone.
 
 
 
• **Desirable** (वांछनीय): Worth having or seeking; beneficial.
 
 
• **Example:** It is desirable to have good communication skills in any career.
